data.title: Documents needed before your start at Beispiel Software Solutions
data.summary: Beispiel Software Solutions GmbH welcomes you and asks you to upload your tax ID, health insurance certificate and residence permit copy to the HR portal by 6 June 2025. Your first working day is 1 July 2025.
data.explanation: Your new employer needs a few documents before it can run your first payroll and register you for social security. Upload your tax identification number (Steuer-ID), your health insurance membership certificate and a copy of your residence permit to the HR portal by 6 June 2025. Without them, the employer says it cannot register you for social security on time. Your first working day is 1 July 2025.
